title: Handoff index: what Claude Code shipped in Anvil and where the details live
what:
Shipped while Claude Code worked on the project (all pushed to origin/main):
- Tier 1 guards: overengineering:unused-new-code and duplication:new-code.
- anvil review log, plus a Quality section in anvil stats.
- Localized Stop and hook messages.
- Orchestrator mode with parallel executors and per-executor SCOPE, plus anvil check --scope.
- Lean executor with a tools allowlist, configured by `anvil orchestrator tools`.
- rustfmt.toml and CI fmt check; pre-commit hook installed.
- Slop benchmark (crates/anvil-cli/slop_bench).
- Mandatory review packet and approval before task_done in orchestrator mode.
- Test-tampering checks on untracked files.
- no-swallowed-errors rule, applied to newly added lines only.
why: An entry point for a new agent or tool (Antigravity). The details are in small topic records so that search finds them.
where: See topic keys: domain:user-working-rules, domain:open-followups, gotcha:install-anvil-binary, gotcha:fmt-clippy-and-test-tampering, gotcha:anvil-allow-format, decision:no-swallowed-errors-applies-to-newly-added-lines-only, decision:orchestrator-review-is-mandatory-and-done-by-the-orchestrator-not-a-reviewer-agent, decision:executor-tool-allowlist-cuts-startup-tokens, quality-findings-precise-blocking
author: reactive-end
